title: The finish score: reward winning fast
question: How often do games end by conquest, and does a yardstick that rewards early wins rank bots differently from points share?
change: A new yardstick. A conquest win scores 75-100% (the earlier, the more), a conquest loss 0-25%, a game stopped at the turn cap 25-75% by points share.
method: Measurement of how the champion's games end, then a re-sweep of the front pull under the new metric
measured: How games end; front pull re-swept
